bank_payments_cash_note.name: bank_payments_cash_note
bank_payments_cash_note.value: "bank_payments"."bank_reference" is not null or "bank_payments"."note" is not null

entries_confirmed_has_payment.name: entries_confirmed_has_payment
entries_confirmed_has_payment.value: "entries"."status" <> 'confirmed' or ("entries"."bank_payment_id" is not null and "entries"."credited_at" is not null)

payout_obligations_entry_kind.name: payout_obligations_entry_kind
payout_obligations_entry_kind.where: "payout_obligations"."entry_id" is not null and "payout_obligations"."superseded_at" is null
